queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Tableau Prep Builder 20%' AND publisher = 'Salesforce, Inc';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Tableau Prep Builder 20%' AND publisher = 'Salesforce, Inc' AND version_compare(version, '24.3.41107') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'tableau prep builder.exe');
